behavior: AC1: systemd, launchd and both Windows launchers run the prefix, then hive, then serve, each element its own argument
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_service.py -q -k 'systemd_command_line or supervisor_loop_runs_the_prefix or carry_the_same_prefixed_loop or runs_it_in_the_unit or inside_the_env_wrapper'

behavior: AC2: the prefix is recorded owner-only, kept by a reinstall without the flag, and cleared by --no-exec-prefix
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_service.py -q -k 'runs_it_in_the_unit or keeps_the_recorded_prefix or restores_the_plain_unit or moved_is_found_again or cli_exec_prefix_takes'

behavior: AC3: an unresolvable launcher, a malformed record, or (Windows) an unquotable element is refused and nothing is written
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_service.py -q -k 'cannot_be_found or cannot_quote or malformed_record or misuse_is_refused'

behavior: AC4: with no prefix every renderer's output is unchanged
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_service.py -q -k 'every_definition_is_unchanged or render_'

behavior: AC5: hive service status names the recorded prefix or says none is recorded
